description: This is a test class for the ExternalIdAdapter, which tests the serialization and deserialization of ExternalId objects using Jackson's ObjectMapper. It contains multiple unit tests that verify conversion accuracy, handling of null and special characters, and interaction with surrounding objects.

classes.name: ExternalIdAdapterTest
classes.description: JUnit test class for testing the JSON serialization/deserialization of ExternalId objects.

classes.name: TestObject
classes.description: Inner static class used for testing serialization and deserialization of objects containing ExternalId fields.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Initializes the ObjectMapper instance before each test.

methods.name: testSerializeExternalId
methods.description: Verifies serialization of an ExternalId with a simple value.

methods.name: testSerializeExternalIdWithSpecialCharacters
methods.description: Verifies serialization of an ExternalId containing special characters.

methods.name: testSerializeNullExternalId
methods.description: Verifies serialization of an ExternalId with null value results in JSON null.

methods.name: testSerializeExternalIdObjectNull
methods.description: Verifies serialization when the ExternalId object itself is null.

methods.name: testDeserializeExternalId
methods.description: Verifies deserialization of a JSON string into an ExternalId object.

methods.name: testDeserializeExternalIdWithSpecialCharacters
methods.description: Verifies deserialization of a JSON string with special characters.

methods.name: testDeserializeNullExternalId
methods.description: Verifies deserialization of JSON null into ExternalId.

methods.name: testRoundTripSerialization
methods.description: Ensures that serializing and then deserializing an ExternalId preserves its value.

methods.name: testRoundTripSerializationWithUUID
methods.description: Verifies round-trip serialization/deserialization with a UUID string.

methods.name: testRoundTripSerializationWithNumericString
methods.description: Verifies round-trip with a numeric string as the ExternalId value.

methods.name: testDeserializeEmptyString
methods.description: Verifies deserialization of an empty string results in an ExternalId with an empty value.

methods.name: testSerializeExternalIdWithEmptyValue
methods.description: Verifies serialization of an ExternalId with an empty string value.

methods.name: testModuleCreation
methods.description: Verifies creation of the ExternalIdAdapter module and checks its name.

methods.name: testDeserializeExternalIdInObject
methods.description: Verifies deserialization of an object containing ExternalId as a property.
